about: Poltergeist 2 ghost-machine: the moving parts and light sprites. Sizes are in design px (1040 x 744 canvas); every PNG is 2x that. "pivot" is in design px inside the sprite. "slice" = 9-slice / 3-slice insets [left, top, right, bottom] in design px. Sprites with "blend": "add" are light: draw them additively (or just alpha-blended) with alpha = light level. No text is baked in: labels are live Poppins text (see ui-layout.json and JUCE-NOTES.md).

assets.name: tap-a
assets.use: Valve tap for the bench and the lower assemblies (draw it scaled to the control's rect). Rotate about the centre, -135..+135 deg.

assets.name: tap-b
assets.use: Valve tap for the bench and the lower assemblies (draw it scaled to the control's rect). Rotate about the centre, -135..+135 deg.

assets.name: tap-c

assets.name: valve-s
assets.use: Small valve wheel: the mix valve on each chamber's pipe and the depth valve that rides on every hose. Rotate about the centre, -135..+135 deg.

assets.name: sel-knob
assets.use: Pointer knob of a stepped dial (saturation, low pass, high pass, drift shape, orbit, orbit rate). Rotate about the centre to the tick of the chosen step.

assets.name: switch-arm
assets.use: Blade of a throw switch. Pivot at the hinge post (bottom); ON = upright in the jaws (0 deg), OFF = thrown over to +52 deg.

assets.name: rod-knob
assets.use: Head of a pull rod / push button (SAVE, LOAD, INIT). Pressed: draw it 2 px lower and 8% smaller for 120 ms.

assets.name: pull-lever
assets.use: Pull lever of the preset picker (prev / next): hangs from its pivot at the top; pulled = swings 24 deg toward the nameplate and springs back.

assets.name: chain-pull
assets.use: Pull-chain of the brass roll: a ring on a chain at the right end of the lower third. Pulled = 14 px lower for 250 ms.

assets.name: lever-knob
assets.use: Grip of a lever in a slotted pipe (orbit SIZE): centre it on the slot at the value position.

assets.name: lens
assets.use: The blend puck: an amber lens in a brass ring (includes its soft halo). Centre it on the blend position.

assets.name: rail
assets.use: The gantry bar the puck rides on: spans the glass, follows the puck's Y (draw it under the lens; its ends ride the two side rails).

assets.name: orbit-arm
assets.use: The clockwork arm of ORBIT: pivot (the gear end) on the orbit centre, the far end on the puck; rotate it to the puck and stretch its length (scale X about the pivot).

assets.name: lantern-A

assets.name: sign-ghosts-lit
assets.use: Hanging page sign GHOSTS (selected: lit), with its two chains. Hangs from the rail: pivot = top centre; it swings a little when touched.

assets.name: needle-big
assets.use: Needle of the output gauge; rotates about the centre (-120..+120 deg, 0 = straight up).

assets.name: needle-small
assets.use: Needle of a chamber's level gauge (-110..+110 deg).

assets.name: pin
assets.use: Pin on the envelope rail. Centre it on the breakpoint.

assets.name: pin-hot
assets.use: Pin on the envelope rail (being dragged / hovered). Centre it on the breakpoint.

assets.name: spark
assets.use: Contact spark of a throw switch: flash it for ~90 ms at the jaws when the switch is thrown (additive).

assets.name: key-white-0
assets.use: White key (worn ivory), up; three variants so the row does not repeat. Draw it clipped to the key's rect from the top (the keys differ a little in length).

assets.name: key-white-1
assets.use: White key (worn ivory), up; three variants so the row does not repeat. Draw it clipped to the key's rect from the top (the keys differ a little in length).

assets.name: key-white-2
assets.use: White key (worn ivory), up; three variants so the row does not repeat. Draw it clipped to the key's rect from the top (the keys differ a little in length).

assets.name: key-white-down
assets.use: White key, held (shadowed at the top, warmed by the lamp).

assets.name: key-black
assets.use: Black key (blued iron), up.

assets.name: key-black-down
assets.use: Black key (blued iron), down.

assets.name: peg
assets.use: A note on the brass roll: a lit slot. 3-slice it along its length (ends fixed) so one sprite covers notes of any length.

assets.name: playhead
assets.use: The travelling playhead lamp of the roll: a little brass carriage on the header rail and a line of light down the rows. Its x follows the step.

assets.name: glow-round
assets.use: Ring of amber light round a wheel, tap or dial well (scale to ~1.5x the control's diameter). Additive; alpha = light level.

assets.name: glow-socket
assets.use: Light in a hose socket: legal targets burn while a hose is dragged; a connected socket glows with the signal. Additive.

assets.name: glow-plate
assets.use: Backlight of a label plate / glass readout: 9-slice it over the plate. Additive; alpha = light level (idle 0.15, hover 0.45, touched 1.0 fading over 600 ms).

assets.name: glow-slot
assets.use: Fire seen through the slot of a slotted pipe (3-slice along its length). Additive.

assets.name: ledger-back
assets.use: The preset ledger: an oiled board hung on two chains from a brass roller, with a head plate, a gutter for the folder tabs and thirteen rails of hooks. Its top-left corner sits sprite_origin left of / above the ledger rect. It unrolls from the roller (clip from the top, 320 ms).

assets.name: ledger-slat0
assets.use: A sound on the ledger: a brass slat hung on two hooks (three variants so the rows do not repeat). Its name is live text.

assets.use: A sound on the ledger: a brass slat hung on two hooks (three variants so the rows do not repeat). Its name is live text.

assets.name: ledger-slat2
assets.use: A sound on the ledger: a brass slat hung on two hooks (three variants so the rows do not repeat). Its name is live text.

assets.name: ledger-slat-lit
assets.use: The slat of the sound that is loaded now: polished and lit (add an amber halo).

assets.name: ledger-foot
assets.use: The foot slat (INIT / EMPTY): verdigris copper.

assets.name: ledger-arrow
assets.use: Page arrow of the ledger (previous page; mirror it for the next page).

assets.name: ledger-tab
assets.use: Folder tab of the ledger (blued iron). Its name is live text.

assets.name: ledger-tab-lit
assets.use: Folder tab of the ledger (the open folder: lit brass). Its name is live text.
